name: ImgSEO – AI Image Alt Text & SEO File Renamer
author: pianoweb

sections.description:
ImgSEO WordPress Plugin is a powerful tool that uses AI to automatically generate SEO-optimized alt text and filenames for your WordPress media library images, improving both search engine rankings and accessibility.

Register for FREE at: https://dashboard.imgseo.net/register and get 30 free credits! (Plus 10 free credits daily)

Key Features

  • Automatic Generation: Get AI-generated alt text whenever you upload new images
  • Bulk Processing: Optimize hundreds of images at once
  • Context-Aware: Uses page content and existing filenames for accurate descriptions
  • Multiple Language Support: Generate alt text in your preferred language
  • SEO Optimization: Improve search engine visibility with quality alt text
  • AI Image Renaming: Automatically generate SEO-friendly filenames using vision AI
  • Smart Analysis: Considers existing filenames to enhance alt text generation
  • Daily Free Credits: Automatically receive 10 free credits every day at midnight when your balance drops below 10 credits

Settings and Options

  • API Key integration (Get yours at https://dashboard.imgseo.net/register)
  • Language selection
  • Context-aware alt text generation using filenames
  • Page title context
  • Maximum character limits
  • Customizable timeouts
  • AI-powered filename optimization
  • Bulk rename capabilities

Visit https://imgseo.net/ for more information.

Pricing Plans

  • FREE: 30 credits upon registration plus 10 free credits daily when your balance falls below 10 credits (replenished automatically at midnight)
    For detailed pricing plans, visit https://imgseo.net/#prices

External services

This plugin connects to our alt text generator engine API, its needed to generate alt text for submitted images.
It sends the image url/data when the user requests for Alt Text generation through a click of the Generate button.
This service is provided by “Img SEO”: https://imgseo.net/terms-of-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/imgseo
  2. Activate plugin
  3. Register at https://dashboard.imgseo.net/register
  4. Enter API key in settings
  5. Start generating alt text and optimizing filenames!
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, register free at https://dashboard.imgseo.net/register to get 30 credits.

What languages are supported?

Multiple languages – select your preferred language in settings.

Can I rename existing image files?

Yes, you can use our AI-powered renaming feature to optimize existing image filenames for SEO.

How does the daily free credits system work?

When your account balance falls below 10 credits, our system will automatically add 10 free credits to your account at midnight. This happens every day, ensuring you always have credits available for essential tasks.
